cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a steaming outdoor hot spring among rocks and bamboo — chest-deep in the water; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — hugs a striped tub of popcorn against her side; a starship data archive — standing; A bright public weather exhibit with a shallow demonstration channel and sunlit glass ceiling — Dressed for the exhibit as an imaginary current reader; A nearly empty civic tram car crossing broad salt flats under a gray-white sky — She spends a rare unhurried commute watching a line of bright mineral pools pass the window while peeling one small orange; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — fans a folding fan open between her hands; the top of a restored ancient city wall — holds her keepsake at chest height; her bedroom — perched on a ledge or edge; a misty enchanted garden of moss — lying on her front; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — sets a small hand lantern down on the ground beside her; a convention photo zone under ring lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a Guan Yu temple — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — standing
